input_narrative: SYNTHETIC NARRATIVE: Synthetic step-down telemetry unit reported that the device failed to flag a clinically significant ventricular tachycardia episode in real time. A retrospective clinician review confirms a single missed, sustained ventricular tachycardia episode that self-resolved with no recorded adverse outcome; no second occurrence has yet been confirmed. The device confidence-score log, the retrospective clinician read, and the raw waveform export are all consistent.

Incident report confirming whether any other similar missed-detection events have occurred since then (to assess recurrence).
risk_report.rationale: The device failed to flag a clinically significant ventricular tachycardia (VT) episode in real-time. Although the event self-resolved with no recorded adverse outcome and was contained by clinician review without immediate harm realization, this represents a failure of a safety-critical function (arrhythmia detection). Under FDA QMSR 21 CFR § 820.10(c), design controls must ensure device performance meets intended use; missing a sustained VT indicates a potential for serious patient harm if the event had evolved differently or occurred in an unmonitored context, satisfying Severity 3 criteria (serious potential patient-safety risk). The lack of a root cause analysis report and incident history regarding recurrence constitutes missing evidence required to fully assess scope. Clinical SHACL nonconformance is triggered by this missed detection.
